# MagicAF

> MagicAF is the open-source Rust AI/ML/NLP framework by **Intracav**. It provides the foundational building blocks for AI systems — embeddings, vector search, LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, and a full NLP toolkit — with zero cloud dependencies. Air-gapped-capable and built for on-premises deployment: designed for hospitals and other environments where data cannot leave the network. It is the framework underneath Lumen, Intracav's clinical AI platform, and this site also documents **Lumen UI**, the component DSL that renders Lumen's AI-generated interfaces.

## How to use this file

This is the structured index of magicaf.intracav.ai for AI agents — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and the like. Every URL here is canonical and citable. Source code lives at https://github.com/magicaf/magicaf.

## API Reference — Core Services

- [Core Services](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/): hub — the core crate's service APIs.
- [EmbeddingService](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/embedding-service/): embedding generation.
- [VectorStore](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/vector-store/): vector storage and similarity search.
- [LlmService](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/llm-service/): LLM orchestration.
- [RAGWorkflow](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/rag-workflow/): the high-level RAG workflow API.
- [Streaming & Tool Calling](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/streaming/): token streaming and tool-call handling.
- [Reranking](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/reranking/): retrieval reranking.
- [Embedding Cache](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/embedding-cache/): caching layer for embeddings.
- [Adapter Traits](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/adapter-traits/): the traits every backend implements.
- [Speech-to-Text (ASR)](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/asr/): audio transcription.
- [Configuration](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/configuration/), [Error Handling](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/errors/), [Resilience](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/resilience/), [Security](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/security/), [Compliance](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/compliance/), [Observability](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/observability/), [Health & Shutdown](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/health-shutdown/), [FFI](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/api-reference/core/ffi/): operational and integration APIs.

## Lumen UI

- [Lumen UI](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/): a declarative component DSL for AI-generated user interfaces — 71 production-ready components across 8 categories, a streaming-resilient parser, and a dynamic prompt system. It is the rendering layer of Lumen, Intracav's clinical AI assistant. End-user product docs live at https://docs.intracav.ai.
- [Introduction](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/introduction/) and [Quick Start](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/quick-start/).
- [Core Concepts](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/core-concepts/): the DSL, parsing, and rendering model.
- [Components](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/components/): the full catalog, by category:
  - [AI](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/components/ai/): streaming text, thinking blocks, tool calls/results, source cards, follow-ups.
  - [Clinical](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/components/clinical/): drug cards, drug interactions, renal dosing, IV drips, triage, differential dx, lab ranges, FHIR patient, clinical notes, guidelines, and more.
  - [Charts](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/components/charts/): line, bar, area, pie, radar, scatter, gauge, sparkline.
  - [Data Display](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/components/data-display/): tables, description lists, code blocks, and related surfaces.
  - [Forms](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/components/forms/): inputs and form controls.
  - [Feedback](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/components/feedback/): alerts, progress, status surfaces.
  - [Layout](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/components/layout/): cards, grids, structural components.
  - [Media](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/components/media/): images and media components.
- [Integration](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/integration/), [Advanced](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/advanced/), [API Reference](https://magicaf.intracav.ai/docs/lumen-ui/api-reference/).
